skill.description: Turns one structured Excel or CSV table into an evidence-traceable HTML business report and an optional editable PPTX. It supports weekly reviews, monthly reviews, and operational retrospectives.

security_audit.summary: All 400 catalogued static findings were adjudicated as false positives after targeted source review. Obfuscation alerts map to readable Chinese text, generated HTML or CSS, and ordinary collection syntax; local command and filesystem operations use bounded arguments and generated directories. No prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found, but 386 scanner matches omitted by the static cap still require cataloguing before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/786 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 386 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The static review catalog was capped at 400 of 786 matches.
remediation.suggestion: Surface and adjudicate the remaining 386 matches before automatic publication, even when they repeat already reviewed patterns.

remediation.issue: Generated demonstration HTML and CSS create excessive obfuscation alerts.
remediation.suggestion: Publish readable source templates or deterministic generation instructions beside generated assets to simplify future audits.

remediation.issue: The bundled 100,000-row CSV exceeds the automated scanner size limit.
remediation.suggestion: Add a deterministic checksum and generation command, or distribute a smaller audit sample with the full dataset separately.

content.value_statement: Business teams often spend hours turning spreadsheet data into clear reports. This skill creates traceable HTML analysis and optional editable presentations from one structured table.
actual_capabilities: Inspects one Excel worksheet or CSV table and identifies fields, time coverage, and metric ambiguities.
Calculates weekly or monthly trends, comparisons, segment breakdowns, ratios, averages, sums, and ending balances.
Links narrative conclusions, charts, and action proposals to deterministic evidence records.
Generates an offline HTML report with data definitions, quality notes, and evidence tables.
Creates an optional editable PPTX after theme selection and presentation quality checks.
Generates synthetic sample data for evaluation without using real company information.
limitations: Each run supports one structured table, not multi-table joins or database connections.
Multi-row headers, merged cells, and combined worksheets require manual preparation.
English output has less acceptance testing than Chinese output.
The skill is not suitable for medical, investment, credit, or employee-rating decisions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a monthly operating review
use_cases.description: Analyze revenue, efficiency, and segment changes, then produce an HTML report for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Explain sales performance
use_cases.description: Compare periods and channels, identify supported drivers, and create a presentation for a sales meeting.

use_cases.title: Review product metrics
use_cases.description: Validate metric definitions, examine trends and segments, and document evidence limits before planning actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a quick HTML report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this spreadsheet for a monthly business review. Ask about definitions that could change conclusions, then create an offline HTML report.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow with one structured table

prompt_templates.title: Confirm the analysis plan first
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this CSV and propose the time range, priority questions, required definitions, and expected output. Wait for approval before generating the report.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan-first workflow for an unfamiliar dataset

prompt_templates.title: Focus on channel efficiency
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze monthly channel performance using revenue divided by total marketing cost. Preserve zero-output costs, compare periods, and explain limitations before recommending actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow with an explicit ratio contract

prompt_templates.title: Build an evidence-bound report and deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a leadership report from this transaction table. Validate grain, returns, cancellations, and period completeness. After HTML approval, generate an editable PPTX.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced transactional analysis with staged presentation delivery

output_examples.input: A monthly channel table with revenue, marketing cost, orders, and visits for the last eighteen months.
output: An offline HTML report summarizing current performance, period changes, and supported channel drivers.
Charts and evidence tables that use confirmed metric definitions and disclose incomplete or missing data.
Action proposals with success signals, guardrails, and stated causal limits.

output_examples.input: A structured sales workbook for a leadership review, followed by a request for presentation slides.
output: A validated HTML analysis that remains the content source of truth.
An editable PPTX using the selected theme, with chart and layout quality checks.

best_practices: Provide one clean table, the intended audience, and the business question before analysis starts.
Confirm date fields, aggregation rules, ratio denominators, and incomplete-period handling when they affect conclusions.
Remove personal or confidential information before sharing the spreadsheet with an AI platform.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated worksheets or tables without preparing one consistent analysis table.
Do not treat descriptive changes as causal proof or use the output for high-stakes decisions.
Do not bypass metric-definition questions when different choices could change the result.

faq.question: Which files can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes one structured Excel worksheet or CSV table per run. Select and prepare one table before starting.

faq.question: Does it require coding?
faq.answer: No. The AI host runs the local scripts, but it must support file access and command execution.

faq.question: What is required for HTML reports?
faq.answer: HTML generation requires Python 3.10 or later and the packages listed in the skill requirements.

faq.question: What is required for editable presentations?
faq.answer: Standard PPTX generation also requires Node.js 18 or later, python-pptx, and a usable preview tool.

faq.question: Does the core workflow upload spreadsheet data?
faq.answer: No publisher-operated upload service is used. The selected AI platform may still process files under its own policies.

faq.question: Can it analyze several worksheets together?
faq.answer: No. Multi-sheet joins and multi-table analysis are outside the current version.
